notes.title: I Love Finding MORE Pups - Now Available!
notes.notes:
The I Love Finding Animals series is back, and it’s brought a bunch of furry new friends with it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42499198/1063f76914b3c25209c5a27f69c0a2f7c244c916.png[/img]

notes.title: Cinco de Mayo Update
notes.notes:
In this Cinco de Mayo update, enjoy 2 new beautiful hidden object scenes. Search for a variety of critters and objects while traveling through scenes inspired by [b]Hidalgo [/b]and [b]Jalisco, Mexico[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41938734/f34b6f0719fc3407e87fd7734824fe8072a58d3c.jpg[/img]

If you like playing I Love Finding Critters and other hidden object games, you may also like our upcoming game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823330/Faircrofts_Antiques_The_Mountaineers_Legacy/]Faircroft's Antiques: The Mountaineer’s Legacy[/url]. Add it to your wishlist now!

notes.title: I Love Finding Critters is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Our newest addition to the I Love Finding Series is now available!

In [b]I Love Finding Critters[/b], the new Hidden Object scenes and mini games come with a whole new set of friends. Unlike before though, these little guys are a whole lot weirder! From Betta fish to chameleons to even Axolotls, all our feisty new friends are dying to meet you!

I Love Finding Critters is now on 25% sale until April 18, 2022 @ 10:00am PDT
